scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict'); const {validationUser,validationLogin}=require('./dist/validators/validationUsers'); const {validationClient}=require('./dist/validators/validationClient'); assert.equal(validationUser.safeParse({name:'Joao Silva',email:'joao@example.com',password:'12345678'}).success,true); assert.equal(validationLogin.safeParse({email:'invalido',password:''}).success,false); assert.equal(validationClient.safeParse({name:'Maria Silva',email:'maria@example.com',cpf:'52998224725',phone:'11999999999',data_nasc:'2000-01-01'}).success,true); console.log('Schemas validados com sucesso.');"
